analytical_capabilities: Form repeat-pass interferograms from compatible Sentinel-1 SLC acquisitions
Estimate interferometric coherence and wrapped phase
Coregister bursts and construct orbit-consistent displacement time series
Unwrap phase and estimate line-of-sight surface displacement
Compare displacement with rainfall, soil moisture and terrain controls

unit_of_measurement.primary_measurement: Complex-valued radar samples preserving amplitude and phase
unit_of_measurement.runtime_hint: Select acquisitions with compatible relative orbit, pass direction, acquisition mode, subswath, burst coverage and polarization. SLC data require precise-orbit application, coregistration, interferogram formation, topographic-phase removal with a DEM, filtering, coherence estimation and phase unwrapping before displacement analysis. Do not treat SLC pixels as terrain-corrected GRD backscatter.
